transcript:
Interviewer: This intake belongs only to the Republic of Alderhaven, a fictional demonstration jurisdiction.
Caller: I am Esme Marl. Juno Marl is my spouse.
Caller: My home is 82 Example Walk Sampletown.
Caller: Our marriage date was 2008-09-13.
Caller: We have two children: Meri Marl born 2010-05-01.
Caller: The second child is Miro Marl born 2015-11-09.
Caller: We separated on 2025-05-19.
Interviewer: You mentioned different arrangements for the siblings.
Caller: Yes. Please record both parts of my proposed schedule.
Caller: Meri Marl stays with Esme Marl on weekdays.
Caller: Miro Marl alternates weeks between Esme Marl and Juno Marl.
Caller: End the marriage. Neither proposed arrangement is an existing agreement.
